Older test file /app/backend/tests/test_iteration43_all_phase_controls.py still uses a localhost fallback for BASE_URL; should rely on REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL only.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend: 10/11 tests passed (only CORS explicit-origin check failed). Verified bcrypt hash prefix ($2b$), httpOnly login cookie, brute-force lockout after 5 fails, policy-gated backup/2FA behavior, training exports non-empty and free of super_admin string, admin_union restrictions, and setup download size=16,553,854 bytes. rca of the issue:
RCA-1 (CORS): App code returns explicit origin in middleware, but public endpoint response still shows wildcard (*), indicating upstream edge/ingress CORS override. Repro: OPTIONS {REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL}/api/auth/login with Origin header.
RCA-2 (Authority logos count): Frontend maps response.login_authority_logos directly when non-empty; if backend returns list length=1, UI renders one editor/image only, not the required fixed 5 slots.
